name: MPU-6050 accelerometer/gyro (GY-521 breakout)
description: 6-axis IMU on a breakout with a 3.3 V regulator; I²C pull-ups go to the regulated 3.3 V.

pins.name: AD0
pins.description: Address select, pulled down on the board: open or low = 0x68, high = 0x69.

notes: MPU-6050 product spec (Rev 3.2) and register map (Rev 4.0): ranges +-2/4/8/16 g and +-250/500/1000/2000 deg/s; noise 400 ug/sqrt(Hz) and 0.005 deg/s/sqrt(Hz); accel output 1 kHz; 3.8-3.9 mA; addresses 0x68/0x69 by AD0. GY-521 has no manufacturer documentation: the VCC range (3.3-5 V, 5 V preferred), pull-ups to the 3.3 V rail and the AD0 pull-down are from ProtoSupplies and the Arduino Playground; typical 5 mA / peak 10 mA adds the regulator and LED (estimate); mass 2 g is an estimate. Wiring XDA/XCL (the aux I²C bus) is not modelled.
